title: BUGFIX — generate-stats-report: on_track field inconsistent with urgency field
rationale: In scripts/scs001/generate-stats-report.ts line 179: `on_track: postsDelivered >= 30` is only true when gate is already PASSED. With 16/30 posts and 13 days left (urgency=ON_TRACK), on_track shows false — contradicting urgency. Fix: on_track should be true when urgency is 'ON_TRACK' or 'PASSED', false when 'FAILED', 'CRITICAL', or 'WARNING'. This makes on_track consistent with urgency and usable as a quick boolean indicator.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/generate-stats-report.ts: change `on_track: postsDelivered >= 30` to `on_track: urgency === 'ON_TRACK' || urgency === 'PASSED'`.
